SELECT
    t1.devregistry AS registry_id,
    t3.hapstr AS durability_score,
    t2.dustres AS dust_resistance_length,
    t2.waterres AS water_resistance_length,
    t2.bendforce AS bend_force,
    t2.physperfref AS calculated_per_value
FROM
    deviceidentity AS t1
JOIN
    interactionandcontrol AS t3 ON t1.devregistry = t3.interactdevref
JOIN
    physicaldurability AS t2 ON t3.interactphysref = t2.physregistry
ORDER BY
    t2.physperfref DESC;

events.sql:
SELECT
    t1.devregistry AS registry_id,
    t3.hapstr AS durability_score,
    t2.dustres AS dust_resistance_length,
    t2.waterres AS water_resistance_length,
    t2.bendforce AS bend_force,
    t2.physperfref AS calculated_per_value
FROM
    deviceidentity AS t1
JOIN
    interactionandcontrol AS t3 ON t1.devregistry = t3.interactdevref
JOIN
    physicaldurability AS t2 ON t3.interactphysref = t2.physregistry
ORDER BY
    t2.physperfref DESC;
